expected_level_description: You can: - own the organisation's annual report and accounts and the accounting policies behind them - advise the board and audit committee on significant judgements and new standards - lead the response to qualified audit opinions or material misstatements - assure that reporting meets public accountability rules

You can: - manage the organisation's cash flow forecast and drawdown of funding - manage bank accounts, payment methods, and banking controls - plan cash for large or irregular payments, such as multi-year software licences

You can: - test and improve the controls for a financial process - manage audit requests for an area and agree actions on findings - write and update financial procedures - work with counter-fraud specialists to reduce fraud risk

You can: - manage the organisation's tax returns and tax reconciliations - advise on the tax treatment of contracts, such as software licences, cloud services, and shared services - maximise tax recovery within the rules

You can: - advise managers on funding rules, including ring-fenced and time-limited funding - manage capital and revenue limits for a programme or directorate - prepare returns and evidence for funders and spending controls

You can: - administer the finance or payroll system, including access, workflows, and reporting - design reports and dashboards for budget holders - test system changes and upgrades - automate repetitive finance tasks
You can: - negotiate, influence or set budgets in complex environments - write or input into business cases and can communicate business-value propositions
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance
